records.jp: どうして女子高に入っちゃったのかしら。^00男子校は無理だけど、せめて共学なら……^00ねぇ？　あなたもそう思わない？
records.en_original: Why'd I enroll in a girls' high school? I couldn't get into a boys' school, but co-ed would've been nice... Right?
records.en_auxiliary: Why'd I enroll in a girls' high school? I can't get into a boys' school of course, but co-ed would've been nice. Right?
records.en: Why did I enroll in an all-girls school?^00A boys' school is obviously impossible, but at least co-ed...^00Right? Don't you think so too?

records.jp: はぁ。私の心を癒してくれるのは小説だけ。^00リアルが……。リアルがほしいのに……
records.en_original: *sigh* All I have are my novels... But I want something real... Real excitement.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* All I have are my novels. But I want something real... Real excitement!
records.en: *sigh* All I have are my novels...^00But I want something real... Real excitement.

records.jp: ……あの子、ちょっと男っぽいわね。^00だとすると……ふむ。^00アリね！
records.en_original: ...Doesn't she kind of look boyish? Wait, maybe... Hmm. That's a possibilty!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Doesn't she kind of look boyish? Wait, maybe... Hmm. That's a possibility!
records.en: ...She's kind of boyish.^00If that's the case... Hmm.^00That's an option!

records.jp: 私、新境地に目覚めたの。^00考えようによっちゃ女子高、おいしいわね。^00ふふ……よだれが出ちゃうわぁ……
records.en_original: I just realized. When you really think about it, an all-girls high school can be kind of...delicious. Hehe... *drool*
records.en_auxiliary: I just realized. When you really think about it, an all-girls high school can be kind of...delicious. Hehe... *Drool*

records.jp: 図書の貸し出し期限は１週間！^00もし破ったら校内放送で呼び出しの上、^00わたしがお説教しちゃいますからね！

records.en_original: There are people who write in our books... If I ever find out who, her punishment will be...severe. Hmhmhmm...

records.en_original: We write a list of recommended books every week in the hopes that more people will start reading...
records.en_auxiliary: We write a list of recommended books every week in the hopes that more people will start reading.

records.jp: 本は読めば読むだけ知識が増えます。^00知識が増えればその人の人生も豊かになる。^00だからみんな、もっと本を読んでください！
records.en_original: The more you read, the more knowledge you'll gain, and knowledge is key to a meaningful life! Read more books!

records.en_original: Hmm, what sort of novel should I write next? One about waking up in another world? Or one about a sci-fi school?

records.en_original: It's hard to write a novel! You have to come up with an idea, make a plot... It's not like writing a letter.
records.en_auxiliary: It's hard to write a novel! You have to come up with an idea, make a plot... It's not like writing a letter.
records.en: Writing a novel is hard, you know?^00You have to come up with ideas, build a plot...^00It's not just putting words on a page.
